Through the smart application of data, IoT and AI, TRIRIGA helps you unlock key information and insights, giving greater visibility into space and facility utilization, occupant experience, capital projects, and lease administration and accounting.
conflict_response: Both proposals agree on binary AI based on the explicit product-specific AI wording, which remains supported.
